scriptLines: query: 'SELECT p.patient_id AS patient_id_bk, p.full_name AS nombre_completo, CASE p.gender WHEN \'F\' THEN \'Femenino\' WHEN \'M\' THEN \'Masculino\' WHEN \'Otro\' THEN \'Otro\' ELSE \'No informado\' END AS genero, p.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento, p.email AS correo_electronico, p.address AS direccion, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.insurance_provider), \'\'), N\'No informado\') AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_paciente d WHERE d.patient_id_bk = p.patient_id)',

source1 derive(edad = year(currentDate('America/La_Paz')) - year(fecha_nacimiento) - iif(toInteger(toString(currentDate('America/La_Paz'), 'MMdd')) < toInteger(toString(fecha_nacimiento, 'MMdd')), 1, 0)) ~> CalcularEdad
CalcularEdad derive(rango_etario = case(isNull(edad) || edad < 0, toString(null()), edad <= 18, '0-18', edad <= 35, '19-35', edad <= 60, '36-60', '61+')) ~> RangoEtario
